# Cow Parsley Living

> A handmade home decor and seasonal gifts shop specializing in personalized ceramic products, vases, and country-inspired home accessories.

Cow Parsley Living is a small business offering artisan-crafted home decor items with a focus on seasonal themes and personalized gifts. The site features a curated shop, lifestyle journal, and customer engagement through their contact and about pages.

## Key Topics

- handmade ceramics
- seasonal home decor
- personalized gifts
- Mother's Day gifts
- ceramic vases
- Easter decorations
- home accessories
- small business
- gift items
- country living
- ceramic products
- flowers and vases
- keepsake gifts
- spring decor
- gift tags
